answer: An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the anchor index resolves every citation against the ocean checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the reef audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 71 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 71 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
